What would have to change is stated in the design note; nothing was changed here.

design: The coverage-guaranteed SAMPLE of the official SLURP test split permitted by owner decision 141: 682 test prompts drawn once, stratified by gold intent with a floor per intent, expanded to all 3010 of their recordings. Its complement SLURP-TEST-CLOSURE-10068-V1 is the closure roster for the final read, sealed at the same moment.
excluded_count_meaning: the parent's recordings that belong to the sibling roster

gold_access.opened_for: stratification of the prompt draw (owner decision 141 item 5) and the TRAIN text-overlap count
gold_access.published_as: per-intent aggregate counts only; no label beside a sample id
gold_access.where: offline, once, inside this sealed model-free freeze process; never at runtime

media_identity: No runtime view exists for this roster. One would be the label-free saea-speech-native-runtime-view-v1 restriction of configs/dataset/slurp-speech-native-test-full.json to these ids, built only under the roster's own allowance; this receipt is the identity statement.
one_read_rule: The closure roster is read ONCE as the final read. The sample serves MILESTONE checks only (decision 141 item 4), never per-round iteration; every milestone is its own owner-named read run id with one attempt, and a roster compared against repeatedly stops being an unbiased final read of itself, which is why its complement -- not the full split -- is the closure roster.
per_stratum_unit: test PROMPTS (utterances) per gold intent; items are the recordings of those prompts
purpose: MILESTONE checks of the programme's absolute 95 per cent intent target on test-distribution rows, behind the final-report owner allowance; never per-round iteration
seed_note: seed 20260927 drives the prompt draw inside each intent; the floors and the mixture apportionment are deterministic arithmetic over the committed capacities
selection_rule: A partition of SLURP-TEST-FULL-13078-V1 by test PROMPT. Prompts are stratified by gold intent (scenario_action, read offline from the governed test.jsonl); per intent the sample takes a floor of 5 prompts where the intent has at least 10, an even split (closure taking the larger half) where it has 2 to 9, and nothing where it has exactly 1 (that prompt goes to the closure roster); the remainder is apportioned by core.roster.mixture_quotas against test's natural prompt mixture, capped by capacity minus both floors. core.roster.freeze_roster draws the prompts (seed 20260927, one shared rng advanced across intents in ascending name order); EVERY recording of a selected prompt goes to the sample and every recording of every other prompt goes to the closure roster. Both receipts are written by one invocation and together they are exactly the parent.

speaker_prompt_author_overlap.statement: Speaker and prompt-author disjointness between the sample and the closure roster is IMPOSSIBLE inside one SLURP split: the same speakers recorded prompts across the whole split and the same authors wrote prompts across it. The partition is by PROMPT, which is what makes the closure roster independent of the sample at the sentence level; the speaker and author overlap below is reported so a reader knows exactly what is and is not shared. Ids are counted in memory and never written.

split_identity_hash_basis: sha256 over the LF-joined sorted carrier-prefixed 'slurp/<sample_id>' ids -- the core.roster / data.splits convention an ExecutionPlan declares
status: FROZEN; MODEL-FREE, ZERO CONTACTS; TEST GOLD READ OFFLINE FOR STRATIFICATION
strata_definition: GOLD INTENT scenario_action of the prompt, read offline for stratification (owner decision 141 item 5) and published as per-intent AGGREGATES only; no item carries its stratum (stratum_withheld_per_item)

stratification.remainder_rule: core.roster.mixture_quotas against test's natural prompt mixture, capped by capacity minus both floors

target_gold_opened_before_receipt_note: TRUE, and deliberately: this receipt is a stratified draw of a gold field, which decision 141 item 5 permits offline and requires to be recorded as exactly that. No score, transcript, answer or model output of any test row exists; the answer surface of both rosters is unread.

dev_reference.note: the same method on devel gave 1 exact match and 113 6-gram-sharing prompts of 913 (DEV-2000-ADDED) and 1 / 111 of 1,000 (DEV-1000)

text_overlap_with_train.method: Digest only, the scripts/build_slurp_dev2000_roster.py method: test sentences are read inside one generator, compared as whole-sentence SHA-256 digests and as word 6-gram digests (rails.proposer.word_ngrams / ngram_digest) against the TRAIN construction text pool, and only counts and digest-set hashes are written. No sentence and no gram is written anywhere. This is the first time a test 'sentence' field has been touched in this repository; it was touched for this count alone, under owner decision 141 item 5 (offline test gold for the sample's construction), and it does not edit the NOT-RUN record of the frozen parent's text pass (protocol section 9 item 3), which stands as written.
text_overlap_with_train.reading: The construction-versus-knowledge guard compares ids, not sentences; these counts say how much of each test roster's TEXT a TRAIN-built knowledge store could already contain. Any non-zero exact match is a property of the corpus, not of the draw, and is reported rather than acted on.

equal_stratum.basis: 1/59 per scored intent present in the test split

natural_mixture.basis: full-test per-intent shares (recordings and prompts); the natural-mixture number is the POST-STRATIFIED sum of per-intent accuracies weighted by these shares, because the floors over-represent small intents and the raw roster mean is not the natural-mixture number
